text: The Draft Plan of Common Elements Condominium application proposes to establish the rear private driveway and one visitor parking space as common elements for the five townhouse units at 2 Baytree Crescent, 2636 A & B Bayview Avenue, and 2638 A & B Bayview Avenue currently under construction. The common elements condominium is required to provide legal pedestrian and vehicular access to the five (5) unit townhouse development and to ensure shared ownership and maintenance of the common elements by the condominium corporation. A concurrent application proposes exemption from the Part Lot Control provisions of the Planning Act to permit the creation of five conveyable lots for the townhouse units.
